walkingDistanceMeters.title: Walkingdistancemeters
walkingDistanceMeters.description: Sum of walk-leg distances; null when any walk leg's distance is unknown, such as a transfer whose street path is unavailable (TRANSFER_STREET_PATH_UNAVAILABLE).

departAt.title: Departat
departAt.description: ISO timestamp with an explicit offset. Exactly one of departAt/arriveBy.

arriveBy.title: Arriveby
arriveBy.description: ISO timestamp with an explicit offset. Exactly one of departAt/arriveBy.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Unique transit modes the engine may use. Walking is always allowed.

maxAccessWalkMinutes.title: Maxaccesswalkminutes
maxAccessWalkMinutes.description: Cap on the first walk before boarding, in whole minutes (1-30). Sent to the engine as maxPreTransitTime. Does not bound walking between transit legs.

maxEgressWalkMinutes.title: Maxegresswalkminutes
maxEgressWalkMinutes.description: Cap on the last walk after alighting, in whole minutes (1-30). Sent to the engine as maxPostTransitTime. Does not bound walking between transit legs.

maxDirectWalkMinutes.title: Maxdirectwalkminutes
maxDirectWalkMinutes.description: Cap on a walk-only alternative, in whole minutes (1-30). Sent to the engine as maxDirectTime.

appliedConstraints.title: Appliedconstraints
appliedConstraints.description: Constraints the adapter sent to the engine, plus disclosures. transferWalkLimit is always not_enforced: walking between transit legs is unbounded and totalled per journey in walkingSeconds. engineWalkCapConformance states whether the engine's enforcement of the caps has been verified.
